question_text: A 35-year-old woman is brought to the inpatient psychiatric unit by the police after she was found violating the conditions of her restraining order by parking on the side street of her "lover’s" home every night for the past week. Her "lover", a famous hometown celebrity, has adamantly denied any relationship with the patient over the past 6 months. The patient insists that ever since he signed a copy of his album at a local signing, she knew they were in love. Despite him having his own wife and children, the patient insists that he is in love with her and goes to his house to meet in secret. Physical examination of the patient is unremarkable. Urine toxicology is negative. Which of the following statements best describes this patient’s condition?
